doc.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
doc.interviewee: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey

title: Self-taught clarinet, favourite clarinettists, brass bands and Kid House
summary: He says he taught himself clarinet, names clarinettists, played violin at King's Hall, parades with the brass band and with Kid House's band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: I taught violin. You taught the clarinet by myself. We're probably talking about violin. Yeah, I taught the clarinet by myself.
You learned the clarinet by yourself? Mm-hmm. Who were some of the best clarinet players you heard in those days? Who did you like? George Buckley. Oh, my name is Rick.
No, no. Oh, my Rick did play the clarinet.
Oakland Wasn't he a good time to play?

Sam Dutre? Yeah, I was playing. He was playing by 19. Sam Dutre? Oh, yeah. I was in seventh grade together in school. Sam Dutre. Yeah, fine musician. Yeah, great. No, I didn't. I used to play with Henry at King's Hall. I was playing violin at the time. I taught different bands. Ten-piece bands. I taught ten-piece bands.
Did you play in parades very much? The brass band?
Yeah, I played in the Barrelton. In the brass band. In the brass band.

I remember one for a parade. He prayed when he came back in California. And he gave him some buzzing breeze for about two weeks. You remember that parade? Yes, indeed. You remember that parade? He was doing up for about two weeks. I don't think he wanted any more after that. I was used to walking in that.

We used to play with the Kid House. And drum, drum, drum. Yeah, he was playing in the Kid House's band too, right? Kid Harris, and I've heard it, yeah. I played in the Kid House's band for about three or four years. Eddie, Eddie, Eddie used to play bass horn.
Did you say you played bass horn too?
Yeah, I taught taught taught taught kind of bass.
